notes.title: Poly Racing Overhaul!
notes.notes:
[i]Poly Racing[/i] is being completely overhauled, and with a new focus on racing karts! After some thought and the realization that there isn't anything special about [i]Poly Racing[/i], we've switched it to karts, and with much more! We are adding multiplayer, full races with AI karts, pit lanes with new tires/refueling available, and you start from racing basic go karts down a neighborhood track. We have been waiting a while and spent much time on the drawing board, and we're excited to share these new updates with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071387/addd3ffefbf86eadd49fe936e27a780233813e35.png[/img]

This coming Saturday, February 5th 2022, you will see a very early build (features missing/incomplete) of the new [i]Poly Racing[/i] as an update for you, and if you don't like it, the current [i]Poly Racing[/i] will be up on another branch. You will also soon see the library/store page marketing and branding change to reflect this complete game overhaul. See you out on the track!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071387/cf26bff39629bc17963af4aa0a32cc96aa3c2d99.png[/img]

notes.title: Manual Transmissions!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071387/b3a0fc6b9c291ac36ddc4fdd289747fa9d8b9c2a.png[/img]
There are now manual transmissions in Poly Racing! Well, technically they are sequential, but now you have control over the transmission. The cars used to just have one gear, but now they have 5. This means that they have a much, much higher top speed. You might ask, where to use this newfangled [i]"speed"[/i]. Well, this means that there will be larger maps coming next update! Manual mode is enabled by default as the automatic logic is pretty stupid with the small tracks, but feel free to turn it off anytime. The shift up/down controls are also configurable.
